categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and modifies standardness rules in 'src/policy/policy.cpp' and 'src/policy/policy.h'.
categories.rationale: Standardizing unstructured Taproot annexes introduces meaningful relay capability for wallets and protocols relying on annex data. The PR addresses the limitation where 'BIP 341 Taproot annexes are currently treated as non-standard by mempool policy, preventing nodes from relaying or accepting standard transactions that utilize annexes', expanding standardness with an opt-in rule to mitigate third-party inflation risks.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Taproot annexes are already consensus-valid under BIP 341; the PR alters standardness policy rather than consensus validity, and mempool policy PRs are excluded from validation.
categories.rationale: The one-line touch to 'src/script/interpreter.cpp' is secondary to the mempool policy change, and consensus rules are unchanged.
